seo.title: Appointments
seo.seo_title: AI appointment booking for small businesses
seo.seo_description: A system takes requests, proposes slots from your calendar, reminds your clients and releases cancelled slots. No slot is confirmed without being checked.

translation.headline: Slots proposed. Reminders sent.
translation.subheadline: The system takes appointment requests, proposes slots from your calendar and reminds your clients. It never confirms an availability it has not checked.

blocks.role: Problème : un petit cabinet qui perd des créneaux.

translation.title: Slots that slip away.
translation.body:
A small practice receives appointment requests by email and by form, often outside opening hours. Confirmations are done by hand, reminders too, and a last-minute cancellation leaves a hole in the day.

The example is constructed to illustrate the principle; it is not a customer's result.

items.title: Requests that wait.
items.text: They arrive in the evening; the reply leaves the next day, sometimes too late.

items.title: Forgotten reminders.
items.text: Each one is a risk of a no-show.

items.title: Late cancellations.
items.text: The freed slot does not get filled.

blocks.role: Ce que fait le système, selon l'agenda connecté.

translation.title: What the system does.
translation.intro: Everything rests on a calendar actually connected to WorkStudio. Without that connection, the system is limited to recording a slot request, confirming nothing.

cards.title: It receives.
cards.text: A request arrives by email or by form. The system pulls out the need and the preferences.

cards.title: It proposes.
cards.text: It looks for open slots in the connected calendar and prepares a reply with two or three options.

cards.title: It confirms after checking.
cards.text: The event is created only once availability is verified in the calendar, and after a person's approval if you decide so.

cards.title: It reminds.
cards.text: A scheduled workflow sends a reminder before the appointment and handles cancellations.

blocks.role: Ce que reçoit l'équipe, bénéfice, et limites vocales.

translation.title: What your team receives.
translation.body:
A calendar that fills while the team works, reminders sent without anyone remembering, cancellations handled. The expected benefit: fewer lost slots and less time spent confirming by hand. No no-show rate and no gain is announced: it is measured during a pilot.

The phone is not included. No call-answering service is delivered today; a voice message dropped in as a recording can be transcribed, and live telephony is checked separately.

items.title: Requests received.
items.text: A clear queue: to handle, proposed, confirmed.

items.title: Prepared reminders.
items.text: The wording is yours, approved once.

items.title: Visible cancellations.
items.text: The freed slot shows up in the calendar at once.

blocks.role: Ce qui reste sous contrôle, y compris la prudence sur les renseignements de santé.

cards.title: No invented slot, ever.
cards.text: Without a connected calendar, the system records a slot request. It does not confirm an unchecked availability.

cards.title: You decide on confirmation.
cards.text: You choose which appointment types are confirmed on their own and which wait for a person.

cards.title: Limited information.
cards.text: For a health or wellness practice, we recommend limiting the system to administrative information (date, time, appointment type). We qualify no clinical use.

cards.title: Reminders are yours.
cards.text: The wording, the timing and the channel are approved by you. Reminders relate to an existing appointment; they are not for prospecting.

cards.title: The location of the data is written.
cards.text: The calendar and the requests stay inside the agreed perimeter; an external service is a disclosed choice.

blocks.role: FAQ propre à la solution rendez-vous.

items.question: Which calendars does it work with?
items.answer: Those that connect to WorkStudio through a connector. Each calendar is qualified during the diagnosis, and some connections require prior registration with the provider.

items.question: Can it answer the phone?
items.answer: No. No call-answering service is delivered today. The solution handles written requests (email, form).

items.question: What happens when two people want the same slot?
items.answer: It checks the calendar at the moment of confirming. If the slot is taken, it proposes another option rather than confirming a double booking.

items.question: Can it be used for care?
items.answer: For administration only: request, slot, reminder. We qualify no clinical use and we recommend not routing health information through it.

translation.title: See the calendar fill.
translation.text: We prepare a demonstration on a fictional calendar, then we talk about yours and your confirmation rules.
